meta.subject: fix warp PDS base addr bug

en.summary: This commit fixes per-wavefront PDS base addressing by carrying the per-wavefront PDS size through CTA scheduling and incrementing the base each time a workgroup is split into successive wavefronts.
why_it_counts: The subject explicitly names a warp PDS base-address bug.
The fix is in CTA scheduling and CU-interface hardware logic, which directly determines memory base addresses seen by the DUT.
Reusing one workgroup base for multiple wavefronts can alias private memory regions and corrupt execution.
disqualifiers: The simulator-side changes are supporting updates, not the primary DUT fix.
evidence: ventus/src/cta/cta_scheduler.scala adds num_pds_per_wf to the host-to-CU metadata.
ventus/src/top/GPGPU_top.scala now forwards host_pds_size_per_wf into CTA scheduling metadata.
ventus/src/cta/cu_interface.scala adds splitter_pds_addr and increments it on each cu_wf_new fire before assigning io.cu_wf_new(i).bits.pds_base.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: When a workgroup is decomposed into multiple wavefronts, each wavefront needs its own private-data base address window. If the control path forwards only the workgroup-level base and never increments it per wavefront, all wavefronts can address the same private-data segment, causing aliasing and memory corruption in any unit that uses that base for local or per-wave data.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A workgroup with more than one wavefront uses a per-wavefront private data space or scratch region whose base should advance for each dispatched wavefront.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Keep the base address constant for all wavefronts in the workgroup instead of stepping it by the per-wavefront allocation size.
portability_notes: Map PDS to any per-wavefront private memory, scratchpad window, or base CSR that is derived during wavefront dispatch.
The bug should live in the scheduler or splitter that expands one workgroup into multiple wavefront launches.
This is easiest to validate with a multi-wavefront workgroup where each wavefront uses a disjoint private-memory region.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the metadata field that carries per-wavefront private-memory size or stride during workgroup dispatch.
Remove its propagation or ignore it when generating each wavefront's base address.
Emit the original workgroup-level base for every wavefront instead of base plus wavefront_index times stride.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CTA splitter logic that derives each cu_wf_new pds_base
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds num_pds_per_wf metadata and uses splitter_pds_addr to step pds_base each time a new wavefront is emitted from a workgroup.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Remove num_pds_per_wf propagation and revert splitter_pds_addr so io.cu_wf_new(i).bits.pds_base always uses the original workgroup base.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Different wavefronts in the same workgroup use overlapping or wrong private-data address ranges, causing corrupted private-memory accesses and incorrect execution results.
evidence_for_injection: The fix adds a new per-wavefront PDS size field rather than just renaming existing signals, showing the old metadata was insufficient.
cu_interface.scala now maintains a dedicated splitter_pds_addr register and increments it on each wavefront dispatch.
The top-level host interface now passes host_pds_size_per_wf explicitly into CTA scheduling.
notes: The cleanest reinjection point is the base-address stepper in cu_interface.scala.
Do not treat the simulator wrapper changes as the primary mutation site.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了每个 wavefront 的 PDS 基地址分配：通过在 CTA 调度路径上传递每-wavefront 的 PDS 大小，并在一个 workgroup 被拆成多个 wavefront 时逐次递增基址。
why_it_counts: 提交标题明确指出了 warp PDS base address bug。
修复位于 CTA 调度和 CU 接口硬件逻辑中，直接决定 DUT 可见的内存基地址。
若多个 wavefront 重用同一个 workgroup 基址，就会让私有内存区域发生别名和破坏。
disqualifiers: 仿真器侧修改是配套更新，不是主 DUT 修复。
evidence: ventus/src/cta/cta_scheduler.scala 在 host-to-CU 元数据中新增了 num_pds_per_wf。
ventus/src/top/GPGPU_top.scala 现在会把 host_pds_size_per_wf 传入 CTA 调度元数据。
ventus/src/cta/cu_interface.scala 新增 splitter_pds_addr，并在每次 cu_wf_new fire 时递增，再写入 io.cu_wf_new(i).bits.pds_base。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当一个 workgroup 被拆分成多个 wavefront 时，每个 wavefront 都需要独立的私有数据基地址窗口。如果控制路径只转发 workgroup 级基址、却不按 wavefront 递增，那么所有 wavefront 都可能访问同一段私有数据区域，进而在任何依赖该基址的本地或每-wave 数据单元中产生别名和内存破坏。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 每-wavefront 私有数据基址传播
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 某个包含多个 wavefront 的 workgroup 使用了应按 wavefront 递增的私有数据空间或 scratch 区域。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让 workgroup 内所有 wavefront 继续使用同一个常量基址，而不是按每-wavefront 分配大小递增。
portability_notes: 可将这里的 PDS 映射到任意在 wavefront 派发阶段派生的每-wavefront 私有内存、scratchpad 窗口或基址 CSR。
该错误应位于把一个 workgroup 展开成多个 wavefront 启动的 scheduler 或 splitter 中。
最适合用包含多个 wavefront 且每个 wavefront 使用不同私有内存区域的工作负载来验证。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位在 workgroup 派发过程中承载每-wavefront 私有内存大小或步长的元数据字段。
删除该字段的传播，或在生成每个 wavefront 的基址时忽略它。
让所有 wavefront 都输出原始 workgroup 级基址，而不是 base 加上 wavefront_index 乘以 stride。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: 为每个 cu_wf_new 生成 pds_base 的 CTA splitter 逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复新增了 num_pds_per_wf 元数据，并通过 splitter_pds_addr 在每次从一个 workgroup 发出新 wavefront 时递增 pds_base。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 删除 num_pds_per_wf 的传播，并回退 splitter_pds_addr，使 io.cu_wf_new(i).bits.pds_base 始终使用原始 workgroup 基址。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 同一 workgroup 内不同 wavefront 会使用重叠或错误的私有数据地址范围，导致私有内存访问损坏和错误执行结果。
evidence_for_injection: 修复新增的是每-wavefront 的 PDS 大小字段，而不是简单重命名，说明旧元数据不足以表达正确行为。
cu_interface.scala 现在维护一个专用的 splitter_pds_addr 寄存器，并在每次 wavefront 派发时递增。
顶层 host 接口现在显式传入 host_pds_size_per_wf。
notes: 最直接的回注点是 cu_interface.scala 中的基址递增器。
不要把仿真包装层修改当作主要突变位置。
